description: Validate and normalize one post without creating it. This does not create records, copy remote media, consume post-item/storage quota, reserve X quota, emit webhooks, or enqueue publication. Third-party media may return remote_media_not_materialized because live create performs storage copy and final byte validation. Use this before showing the final preview and asking for confirmation to call create_post.

caption.description: The post caption/text content. On Instagram, @username is a caption mention, not a native tag or collaborator invite. Optional on Instagram Stories (first slide only in a series). Ignored when `thread_posts` is provided.

instagram_settings.description: Instagram-specific settings. If “tag” is ambiguous, distinguish caption @mentions (put @username in caption), native media tags (user_tags), and co-author invitations (collaborators). Native media tags work with eligible direct or Meta-linked accounts; collaborators require an eligible Meta-linked account. Call list_platforms with view=schema and account_id first.

audio_id.description: Licensed Instagram audio ID for Reels. Meta-linked Facebook Login accounts only.

caption_addon.description: Optional Instagram caption add-on. type is none, poll, or comment_prompt. A poll needs 2 to 4 options of 1 to 25 characters (an emoji counts as one) and the caption is the question. A comment prompt uses the caption as the prompt. Facebook Login only. Not available on Stories. At most one add-on per post. Pass null or type none to clear it.

collaborators.description: Native Instagram co-author invitations. Meta-linked accounts only; feed images, Reels, and carousels; not Stories.

is_ai_generated.description: Label the parent Instagram media container as AI-generated. For carousels, set on the parent only.

is_comment_prompt_used.description: Set true to attach an Instagram comment prompt. The caption is the prompt. Mutually exclusive with a poll. Facebook Login only. Not available on Stories.

is_poll_duration_extended.description: Set true only together with a poll, to request the longer Instagram poll duration.

media_accessibility.description: Preferred ordered media alt text. Identity follows index/asset_id through platform media preparation; media_alt_texts remains the legacy URL-map form.

poll_attachment.description: Instagram poll choices. option_a and option_b are required, option_c and option_d are optional, and option_d requires option_c. Mutually exclusive with a comment prompt. The caption is the question. Serialised JSON must be 200 characters or fewer.

user_tags.description: Native clickable media tags, not caption @mentions. Supported by eligible direct Instagram and Meta-linked connections; feed images, Reels/video, and Stories. Tags apply to each carousel item and the first Story in a Story Series.

media_url.description: Media URL to attach. Posterly storage URLs are used as-is; third-party HTTP(S) URLs are copied into posterly storage before the post is saved. Short-lived signed URLs must still be live when this tool runs. For threads, attaches to the lead post only.

media_urls.description: Multiple media URLs for carousel or multi-image posts. Posterly storage URLs are used as-is; third-party HTTP(S) URLs are copied into posterly storage before the post is saved. For TikTok, 2 or more images auto-create a photo slideshow (up to 35 images) and every image is posted.

platform.description: Platform name (required with username). Supported: instagram, facebook, tiktok, twitter, linkedin, youtube, pinterest, threads, google_business, telegram, bluesky, discord, slack, mastodon, devto, hashnode, wordpress, lemmy. Aliases such as x, gmb, and instagram-standalone are accepted.

platform_settings.description: Platform-specific settings for the selected account. Use this for non-Instagram settings and prefer it over raw metadata.

media_accessibility.description: Preferred ordered media alt text. Identity follows index/asset_id through platform media preparation; media_alt_texts remains the legacy URL-map form.

post_type.description: Optional post type: text, image, video, carousel, reel, story, story_series, document, photo, cover_photo, x_thread, or threads_thread. Omit it for auto-detection from media. For TikTok photo posts, use photo/image/carousel or omit it; for Facebook cover photos, use cover_photo or platform_settings.post_type.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime for scheduling (e.g. 2026-03-05T09:00:00Z). Omit for immediate publish.

thread_posts.description: For X or Threads only: array of 2+ strings, one per post in the thread. The first entry leads, the rest reply in order. When set, the platform must be twitter or threads.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to assign the post to (from whoami). If omitted, uses the account's workspace or the caller's default workspace.

name: validate_post
